title: Senior Corporate Counsel, Datacenters and Infrastructure
location: Seattle; All Other Locations
posting_excerpt:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world. 

We are looking to add a Senior Corporate Counsel, Datacenters and Infrastructure, who is passionate about solving complex legal challenges at the leading edge of artificial intelligence and cloud computing.

As a Senior Corporate Counsel, Datacenters and Infrastructure, reporting to the Associate General Counsel at DigitalOcean, you will join a small and dynamic team dedicated to revolutionizing cloud computing and AI. DigitalOcean's mission is to simplify cloud computing and AI so that builders and businesses can spend more time creating software that changes the world. In this role, you will focus on high-value transactions to procure, build, and operate the physical infrastructure that enables Digital Ocean’s services, including projects and agreements involving datacenter leasing and operations. Working alongside dedicated datacenter commercial, technical, security, and regulatory colleagues, you will guide critical physical infrastructure transactions to drive development projects.

What You’ll Do:

- Serve as a trusted partner and a primary legal contact to drive datacenter related agreements to signature (e.g., LOIs, MSAs, order forms, and ancillary agreements). 

- Draft, review, and negotiate agreements supporting the building, deployment, and operation of datacenters, including datacenter capacity leasing, colocation, and design/build agreements; facilities/operations and maintenance agreements; and infrastructure procurement agreements for GPUs and other compute hardware, integrated server systems, network equipment, power equipment, and other datacenter infrastructure.

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across datacenter procurement, engineering and operations, finance, tax, and compliance functions on deal structuring.

- Provide business-focused counseling on risk allocation, supplier risk assessments, and supplier and product performance and remediation matters.

- Support international expansion by adapting requirements for new jurisdictions and coordinating with local counsel on local law and market issues.

- Build scalable legal tools directed to infrastructure transactions including templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and approval matrices to improve contracting speed and consistency.

- A willingness to work on other high-priority legal work to help a lean Legal Department (e.g., key vendor and operations agreements).

What You’ll Need:

- Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and active bar membership in at least one U.S. state.

- 8+ years of legal experience and 3+ years of significant in-house experience supporting datacenter or similar large-scale infrastructure projects.

- Proven experience with datacenter contracts from a developer/ provider or tenant perspective, including single tenant and/ or colocation deals involving modified-gross, triple net or other lease structures. 

- Experience with facilities agreements, and operations-and-maintenance contracts.

- Familiarity with datacenter operational requirements (e.g., SLA constructs, maintenance windows, security requirements, audit rights, change control, and service credits), tax incentives, and financing structures. 

- Experience managing multiple projects with minimal oversight to meet aggressive timelines while delivering high-quality work product.

- A low-ego, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude to tackle projects large and small, a desire to learn, an appetite for feedback, and a "leave it better than you found it" growth mind

The Operations team at Airwallex sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and customer experience. The Operations Strategy function drives process optimization, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional program delivery across Airwallex's global operations. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Legal, Security, and Data teams to solve complex problems at scale, ensuring that our operational infrastructure keeps pace with Airwallex's rapid growth. This role sits within the Operations Strategy team and is focused on driving our Data and AI Governance Program, a critical cross-functional initiative.

You will work at the intersection of program management and operations strategy, facilitating working groups across IT, Security, Engineering, Legal, and Data teams to design and operationalize data and AI governance frameworks that reduce data access and use risks while supporting business operations. You'll play a key role in developing and executing discovery strategy for a sophisticated national litigation portfolio on behalf of a major international law firm client. You'll work alongside experienced attorneys, engage directly with in-house and outside counsel, and help shape discovery approaches that influence cases across the country.

This role is ideal for an attorney who enjoys investigation, issue-spotting, strategic analysis, and working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where every day presents new challenges.

The Position

- Investigate complex litigation matters and identify case-specific discovery issues before they become problems.

- Draft thoughtful, well-supported discovery responses and objections tailored to the unique facts of each case while maintaining consistency with broader national litigation strategies.

- Partner with in-house counsel and outside law firms to develop practical, strategic discovery solutions.

- Analyze trends across cases and contribute to the development of best practices and national discovery initiatives.

- Work collaboratively with a highly skilled legal team in a dynamic environment that values critical thinking, innovation, and continuous improvement.

- Help identify opportunities to improve discovery processes, reduce risk, and drive greater efficiency.

What We're Looking For

- Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school

- Active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

- Experience handling litigation discovery, investigations, or complex civil litigation.

- Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to identify legal and factual issues quickly.

- Outstanding legal writing and communication skills.

- A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with attorneys across multiple teams and jurisdictions.

- Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

- Experience using AI tools and large language models to enhance legal workflows is a plus.

- Personal injury litigation experience is preferred.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to move beyond routine discovery work and become part of a team that helps shape litigation strategy on a national scale. You'll work on challenging, meaningful matters, collaborate with accomplished legal professionals, and make a tangible impact for a premier international law firm client.

If you're looking for a role that combines strategic thinking, collaboration, and sophisticated litigation work, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Wilson Elser?

- Meaningful Work: Handle sophisticated matters alongside experienced attorneys and partners

- Collaborative Culture: Work in a supportive team environment that values mentorship and professional development 

- Advancement: Gain opportunities for long-term growth within a nationally recognized firm

- Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy a flexible hybrid work arrangement that supports work-life balance

- Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive compensation, generous PTO, 401(k) match, and robust medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage

- Additional Perks: Access to corporate discount programs and employee benefits

Wilson Elser welcomes submissions of candidates for our open positions exclusively from recruitment agencies with an active, signed fee agreement who have been granted access to a position through our dedicated Recruitment Agency Portal. We are unable to consider submissions from recruitment agencies without a current (dated as of 7/1/2024) agreement in place. We appreciate your understanding. For collaboration inquiries or to establish an agreement, please contact us at talentacquisition@wilsonelser.com.
